title: A/R Collection groups by customer with counts, totals and Totals
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has two past-due invoices.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Read customer X's group row.
  4. Click the arrow button on customer X.
  5. Read the line after customer X's last document.
  6. Read the bottom row of the report.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • customer X's name with (2), and "Total" with the Amount and Open balance.

Step 5:

  • "Total for" followed by customer X's name, with the two amounts.

Step 6:

  • "Totals" with the Amount and Open balance.

Why this matters: The call list is worked customer by customer.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingCollectionReport.vue:79-108; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingCollectionReport.vue:140-183.
